bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to environment; appropriating money for PFAS biomonitoring.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; EAST METRO PFAS BIOMONITORING.

$365,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $710,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the environmental fund to the commissioner of the Pollution Control Agency for transfer to the commissioner of health to continue per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) biomonitoring in eastern metropolitan communities. This appropriation is available until expended.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: $365,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $710,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the environmental fund to the commissioner of the Pollution Control Agency for transfer to the commissioner of health to continue per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) biomonitoring in eastern metropolitan communities. This appropriation is available until expended.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
